lines.t: Yeah…
Truth callin’…
Yeah, the Word came in
Silence broke
Light in the dark, light in the dark
Every hidden thing laid bare in that spark
He got me awake, fire in my bones
Voice like thunder breaking every stone
Truth in the Word when He speaks
Life in the breath when He breathes
Spirit on fire, all the lies exposed
Every page burn like a warning inside me
World say “stay asleep” but the Truth come and find me
Truth cut deep, set me apart
He got me awake, fire in my bones
Voice like thunder breaking every stone
Truth in the Word when He speaks
Life in the breath when He breathes
Spirit on fire, all the lies exposed
If I fall, You still remain
Wash me clean in the holy rain
Hands lifted high when You call
Life in the breath when You fall
Lord You holy, holy, holy, holy
